The plate is about 345 px wide in the image. If it is a dinner plate of roughly 26 cm, that gives about 13 px per cm.

The food is a corn cob piece seen end-on. It is about 95 px across, so roughly 7 cm in diameter. Its height is unknown, perhaps 3 to 4 cm, so it is a short cross-section of a cob.

I treat the piece as a cylinder with a 6.5 cm diameter and a 3.5 cm length. Its volume is about π × 3.25² × 3.5 ≈ 116 cm³. Because the cob core is included, I use a density of about 0.7, which gives roughly 80 g. A cob slice of this size probably weighs 70 to 90 g including the core, so I estimate 80 g.

Boiled corn on the cob is about 96 kcal per 100 g.
